graph_decision.evidence: J1 (index 525) shows an abrupt upward step in all three components (N, E, U), followed by sustained elevated displacement until J2 (index 587), where a sharp downward step returns the series near its pre-J1 level. The subtracted auxiliary plots confirm that the offset is not part of the slow trajectory—residuals show near-zero baseline before J1, a persistent offset between J1 and J2, and return to baseline after J2. No other persistent steps remain; the pattern matches a transient platform with interior permanent shift ruled out by continuity of trajectory before/after.
